verdict.rationale: Alacritty's configuration is a plain-text TOML file (alacritty-docs-17) covering extensive settings: colors, fonts, window, env, shell and keybindings (alacritty-docs-38, -23, -44, -40). It supports imports that are loaded in order and skip missing files (alacritty-docs-14), which suits machine-specific overrides in synced dotfiles, and live reload is on by default (alacritty-docs-39). Missing for 10: documented config file locations/search paths, independent or hands-on corroboration of dotfiles-based syncing across machines.
